Job Description

Specialist - Data Sciences

Job Description Python GEN AI Developer

We are seeking a talented and AIoriented Python Developer If you are passionate about leveraging Generative AI to solve real business problems we would be delighted to discuss this opportunity with you

Responsibilities

Backend development using Python for our products and customer projects

Experience working with Azure Tech stack App Service DevOps AI Studio Redis

Develop and optimize RAG RetrievalAugmented Generation applications and build RESTful APIs with Flask or similar python frameworks

Optimize code for performance scalability and reliability

Troubleshoot and debug technical issues related to backend services

Write clear and concise technical documentation and maintain well documented codebase

Requirements

Must have a minimum of 5 year of backend development experience with proven experience in Python

Must have relevant experience developing and deploying backend services using Python frameworks Flask Django Fast API

Good understanding of commonly used data structures and algorithms

Good understanding software engineering concepts like OOPs Threading and Multiprocessing Caching

Must have strong skills in RDBMS SQL and database design

Good to Have

Experience working with OpenAI APIsother LLMs

Experience working with embedding techniques and vector databases

Work with Langchain LLMs Large Language Models and OpenAI to create advanced functionalities

Experience working with caching systems like Redis

Familiarity with tools and libraries like Numpy Pandas PyTorch TensorFlow and Scikitlearn

Experience working with chatbots

Qualification

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science Information Technology or related field from a tier 1 or tier 2 colleges or universities

Relevant certifications in emerging technologies
